title: prunella vulgaris var. hispida
intro: Prunella vulgaris var. hispida, commonly known as self-heal, is a perennial plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Prunella vulgaris var. hispida include wound healing, immune system support, and the alleviation of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
